name: Acolyte
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Intelligence** or **Wisdom**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Religion skill and the Scribing Lore skill. You gain the [Student Of The Canon](/feat/student-of-the-canon-player-core) skill feat.

name: Acrobat
descr:

descr:

You're trained in the Nature skill and a Lore skill related to one terrain inhabited by animals you like (such as Plains Lore or Swamp Lore). You gain the [Train Animal](/feat/train-animal-player-core) skill feat.

You're trained in the Stealth skill and the Underworld Lore skill. You gain the [Experienced Smuggler](/feat/experienced-smuggler-player-core) skill feat.

descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Intelligence** or **Charisma**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Occultism skill and a Lore skill related to your deity or cult. You gain the [Schooled In Secrets](/feat/schooled-in-secrets-player-core) skill feat.

name: Detective
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Intelligence** or **Wisdom**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Society skill and the Underworld Lore skill. You gain the [Streetwise](/feat/streetwise-player-core) skill feat.

descr:

You're trained in the Society skill and a Lore skill related to one city you've visited often. You gain the [Multilingual](/feat/multilingual-player-core) skill feat.

name: Entertainer
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Dexterity** or **Charisma**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Performance skill and the Theater Lore skill. You gain the [Fascinating Performance](/feat/fascinating-performance-player-core) skill feat.

name: Farmhand
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Constitution** or **Wisdom**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Athletics skill and the Farming Lore skill. You gain the [Assurance](/feat/assurance-player-core) skill feat with Athletics.

name: Field Medic
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Constitution** or **Wisdom**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Medicine skill and the Warfare Lore skill. You gain the [Battle Medicine](/feat/battle-medicine-player-core) skill feat.

name: Fortune Teller
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Intelligence** or **Charisma**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Occultism skill and the Fortune-Telling Lore skill. You gain the [Oddity Identification](/feat/oddity-identification-player-core) skill feat.

descr:

You're trained in the Deception skill and the Games Lore skill. You gain the [Lie To Me](/feat/lie-to-me-player-core) skill feat.

You're trained in the Performance skill and the Gladiatorial Lore skill. You gain the [Impressive Performance](/feat/impressive-performance-player-core) skill feat.

You're trained in the Intimidation skill and the Legal Lore or Warfare Lore skill. You gain the [Quick Coercion](/feat/quick-coercion-player-core) skill feat.

name: Herbalist
descr:

You're trained in the Nature skill and the Herbalism Lore skill. You gain the [Natural Medicine](/feat/natural-medicine-player-core) skill feat.

You're trained in the Nature or Occultism skill, plus a Lore skill related to the terrain you lived in as a hermit (such as Cave Lore or Desert Lore). You gain the [Dubious Knowledge](/feat/dubious-knowledge-player-core) skill feat.

name: Hunter

name: Martial Disciple
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Strength** or **Dexterity**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in your choice of the Acrobatics or Athletics skill. You gain a skill feat: [Cat Fall](/feat/cat-fall-player-core) if you chose Acrobatics or [Quick Jump](/feat/quick-jump-player-core) if you chose Athletics. You're also trained in the Warfare Lore skill.

name: Merchant
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Intelligence** or **Charisma**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Diplomacy skill and the Mercantile Lore skill. You gain the [Bargain Hunter](/feat/bargain-hunter-player-core) skill feat.

name: Miner
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Strength** or **Wisdom**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Survival skill and the Mining Lore skill. You gain the [Terrain Expertise](/feat/terrain-expertise-player-core) skill feat with underground terrain.

name: Noble
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Intelligence** or **Charisma**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Society skill and the Genealogy Lore or Heraldry Lore skill. You gain the [Courtly Graces](/feat/courtly-graces-player-core) skill feat.

name: Nomad
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Constitution** or **Wisdom**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Survival skill and a Lore skill related to one terrain you traveled in (such as Desert Lore or Swamp Lore). You gain the [Assurance](/feat/assurance-player-core) skill feat with Survival.

name: Prisoner
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Strength** or **Constitution**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Stealth skill and the Underworld Lore skill. You gain the [Experienced Smuggler](/feat/experienced-smuggler-player-core) skill feat.

name: Raised by Belief
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to an attribute specified in your deity's **Divine Attribute**, and the other is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the deity's listed Divine Skill and gain the [Assurance](/feat/assurance-player-core) feat with that skill. You gain a Lore skill related to your deity (Abadar Lore, for example).

name: Sailor
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Strength** or **Dexterity**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Athletics skill and the Sailing Lore skill. You gain the [Underwater Marauder](/feat/underwater-marauder-player-core) skill feat.

name: Scholar
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Intelligence** or **Wisdom**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in your choice of the Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion skill, and gain the [Assurance](/feat/assurance-player-core) skill feat in your chosen skill. You're also trained in the Academia Lore skill.

name: Scout
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Dexterity** or **Wisdom**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Survival skill and a Lore skill related to one terrain you scouted in (such as Forest Lore or Cavern Lore). You gain the [Forager](/feat/forager-player-core) skill feat.

name: Street Urchin
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Dexterity** or **Constitution**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Thievery skill and a Lore skill for the city you lived in as a street urchin (such as Absalom Lore or Magnimar Lore). You gain the [Pickpocket](/feat/pickpocket-player-core) skill feat.

name: Teacher
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Intelligence** or **Wisdom**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in your choice of either the Performance or Society skill, as well as the Academia Lore skill. You gain the [Experienced Professional](/feat/experienced-professional-player-core) skill feat.

name: Tinker

You're trained in the Crafting skill and the Engineering Lore skill. You gain the [Specialty Crafting](/feat/specialty-crafting-player-core) skill feat.

You're trained in the Intimidation skill and the Warfare Lore skill. You gain the [Intimidating Glare](/feat/intimidating-glare-player-core) skill feat.
